rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR GOVERNMENT FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS UNIFIED INITIATIVES TO DISTRESSED ENTERPRISES FOR ECONOMIC RECOVERY (GUIDE)
rows.title_short: Government Financial Institutions Unified ( G F Is) Unified Initiatives To Distressed Enterprises For Economic Recovery ( G U I D E)
rows.abstract: Seeks to strengthen the capacity of Land Bank of the Phils. and the Development Bank of the Phils. to provide the needed assistance to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), and other strategically important companies; Proposes to mandate that these GFIs expand their credit and rediscounting facilities to affected MSMEs in the agriculture, infrastructure, manufacturing, and service industries; Aims to create a special holding company to be a major player in the financial and capital markets by providing aid to strategically important companies with solvency/liquidity issues brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic and mandating LBP and DBP to maintain at least majority ownership over such SHC until they have recovered their investment.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE TRANSITION OF THE GOVERNMENT TO E-GOVERNANCE IN THE DIGITAL AGE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to establish an integrated, interconnected, and interoperable information, resource sharing, and communications network through several provisions enumerated and discussed in this Act regarding the following: the Role of the DICT; the Integrated Government Network (re: paper-based workflows, etc.); the Phil. individual Information Database and Civil Registration System; the Public Service Directory; the Service Portal for Individuals and Business (government frontline services, online payment system, citizen's concerns center, cooperation of government agencies and LGUs, etc.); the Online Public Service; the Phil. Citizen Connect Program (free internet access for the public, provision of internet-capable devices in all barangays; the Government Websites and E-Bulletin Boards; Data Information Security; Phil. Infrastructure Management Corp.(PIMC); and the ICT Academy.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION TO CONSUMERS AND MERCHANTS ENGAGED IN INTERNET TRANSACTIONS, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE THE ELECTRONIC COMMERCE BUREAU, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Intends to address concerns that will facilitate transactions and cross-border trade processes; Seeks to promote an environment founded on trust among consumers and merchants as a means to increase the number of e-commerce participants; Proposes to create an eCommerce Bureau to act as a virtual central unit tasked to receive and address consumer complaints on internet transactions, facilitate their speedy resolution by the respective agency, and track complaints referred to or initiated by the concerned agency - to ensure the speedy and appropriate action on those complaints, among other related powers and functions of the Bureau; Seeks to apply provisions in this Act to transactions related to Internet retail of consumer goods and services, online travel services, online media provider, ride-hailing services, and digital financial services; Discuss provisions regarding obligations of consumers and providers of RideHailing Services; On-line Dispute Resolution, and E-Commerce Phil. Truswork.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FREE LEGAL ASSISTANCE TO ANY OFFICER OR UNIFORMED PERSONNEL OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES, THE BUREAU OF FIRE PROTECTION, THE BUREAU OF JAIL MANAGEMENT AND PENOLOGY, THE PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD, AND THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, FACING ANY CHARGE BEFORE THE PROSECUTOR´S OFFICE, COURT OR ANY COMPETENT BODY ARISING FROM AN INCIDENT RELATED TO THE PERFORMANCE OF OFFICIAL DUTY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Proposes several legal services to be included in the free legal assistance as follows:  legal representation in all stages of civil, criminal, or administrative cases; legal advice or consultation; preparation of pleadings, motions, memoranda, and all other legal forms and documents; notarization of documents; and all other legal services and tasks as directed by the heads of the officers and uniformed personnel; Includes provisions among others: qualifications to avail of free legal assistance in cases involving service-related incidents; procedure to avail the services; the entitlement of government lawyer to payment for expenses; and the appearance of private counsel.

rows.abstract: Seeks to conduct an in-depth studies on viruses and their potential disease-causing agents that affect people, plants, and animals in order to provide scientific bases for the treatment of viral diseases; Proposes to create the VIP as the premier research Institute in the field of virology which shall be a venue for scientists, research institutes, and other organizations to work collaboratively to study viruses of agricultural, industrial, clinical, and environmental importance.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO FURTHER DEVELOP CAPABILITY AND ESTABLISH EXPEDITIOUS TRANSFORMATION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF NATIONAL DEFENSE AND ITS BUREAUS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide a mechanism for the coordination of departments and agencies in addressing multi-dimensional facet of national defense and security, and to achieve a common understanding of its issues by providing the facility for consensus building and consultation processes; Proposes several provisions among others regarding: mandatory military service; the National Defense Council which mandates DND to exercise supervision and control over the AFP, Government Arsenal, Office of Civil Defense, Phil. Veterans Affairs Office (PVAO) and the National Defense University of the Phils.; management and control of defense real properties; functions of the Phil. Army, Phil. Air Force, and Phil. Navy; Women's Auxiliary Corps; Phil. Military Academy.

rows.author: F061;I059;K051;K119;
rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA12231 enacted on 2025-08-04
rows.title_full: AN ACT RIGHTSIZING THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT TO IMPROVE PUBLIC SERVICE DELIVERY
rows.abstract: Aims to improve public service delivery by minimizing duplication, redundancy, or overlapping in functions through designing an organizational structure that shall function effectively in the context of good governance and fiscal prudence; Intends to authorize the President to rightsize the Executive Branch while the Legislative, the Judiciary, the Constitutional Commissions, may likewise rightsize their respective offices; local Government Units may also rightsize their respective offices, subject to their financial capability while the Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCG) shall continue to exercise its authority under R.A. No. 10149.

rows.author: F061;I059;K119;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF DISASTER RESILIENCE, DEFINING ITS MANDATE, POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Proposes to create a Department that will have a full-time focus on natural hazards and disasters, which is characterized by unity of command, a science and ICT-based approach, and the capacity to take charge of three key result areas: disaster risk reduction; disaster preparedness, and response; and recovery, rehabilitation and building forward better;
Provides among others, some key elements and features of the proposed Department regarding the take-over capacity of any private utility; rationalized fund-use and fast and responsive procurement; highly specialized functions, and highly-skilled personnel requirements (scientists, environmental and/or urban planners, civil engineers, and public finance specialist); and institutional partnership with LGUs, NGOs, and academia.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2022-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING  THE REGISTRATION OF SUBSCRIBER IDENTITY MODULE CARDS
rows.title_short: Subscriber Identity Module ( S I M ) Card Registration Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to regulate the sale and distribution of SIM cards to promote end-user accountability, prevent the proliferation of mobile phone scams and data breaches, and to assist law enforcement agencies in resolving crimes involving the use of mobile phone units.
Proposes that every public telecommunication entity (PTE) or direct seller shall require the end user of a SIM card to present a valid ID document with photo; to accomplish and sign a control-numbered registration form; and an attestation by the end user that the person appearing before the direct seller is the same person who accomplished and signed the form and that the ID presented are valid and correct. 
Provides for other detailed requirements in the process of registration, providing penalties for non-compliance to any provisions of this Act.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE USE OF TREATMENT TECHNOLOGY FOR MUNICIPAL AND HAZARDOUS WASTES, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 20 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8749, ENTITLED "THE PHILIPPINE CLEAN AIR ACT OF 1999"
rows.abstract:
Proposes to amend Sec.20 of R.A. 8749 or the Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999, and certain provisions from R.A.9003 or the Ecological Solid Waste Management with regard to the ban on incineration of waste.
Intends to address the persistent garbage problem of the country by allowing the use of modern options using thermal treatment units employing a Waste-to-Energy (WTE) or energy-from-waste that process non-renewable waste to reduce environmental and health damages while generating sustainable energy.

rows.author: F061;I059;K119;
rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA12076 enacted on 2024-12-06
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING EVACUATION CENTERS IN EVERY CITY AND MUNICIPALITY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Aims to establish a standard-based evacuation centers to decongest public schools and private facilities evacuation centers which shall be a permanent recourse in times of calamities and natural or man-made disasters such as typhoons, floods, storm surges, drought and other severe climate disturbances, as well as fire and the outbreak of illnesses and diseases.
Provides for the following provisions: minimum requirements for every evacuation center such as location designation, structural and building capacity, amenities and accessibility; the role of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC); and for the coordination with the DPWH and the DOST with regard to the design specifications, cost estimates, and construction details.

rows.author: F061;I059;K119;
rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA12120 enacted on 2025-01-08
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE DOWNSTREAM NATURAL GAS INDUSTRY, CONSOLIDATING FOR THE PURPOSE ALL LAWS RELATING TO THE TRANSMISSION, DISTRIBUTION AND SUPPLY OF NATURAL GAS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Provides for several key provisions among others as follows:  mandate the Department of Energy to be the lead agency responsible for the supervision and monitoring of the Industry and the regulation of the construction and operation of natural gas pipelines and related facilities for the transmission, distribution, and supply of natural gas; stipulates that the Energy Regulatory Commission shall have the sole regulatory responsibility for establishing the rates and related terms and conditions of service for the transmission and distribution, regasification and supply of natural gas; states the powers and responsibilities of the DENR, DOH, DTI (Bureau of Phil. Standards), and the Philippine Competition Commission (PCC).

rows.author: F061;I059;K051;K119;
rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA12009 enacted on 2024-07-20
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9184, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "GOVERNMENT PROCUREMENT REFORM ACT" AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes for the following provisions:  mandatory inclusion of the procurement plan and purchase priority in the annual development plan, the inclusion of the list of requirements in the posting and publication of the invitation to bid, upgrading the Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) and establishment of the electronic bidding process.
Seeks to introduce Best Value Procurement (BVP); adoption of Global Open Data Contracting Standards; promotion of Sustainable Public Procurement; support to Inclusive Public Procurement, which incentivizes the participation of MSMEs in government procurement; and institutionalization of a Procurement Academy, among others.

rows.author: F061;I059;K119;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REFORM THE BUDGET PROCESS BY ENFORCING GREATER ACCOUNTABILITY IN PUBLIC FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT (PFM), PROMOTING FISCAL SUSTAINABILITY, UPHOLDING CONGRESS´ POWER OF THE PURSE, INSTITUTING AN INTEGRATED PFM SYSTEM, AND INCREASING BUDGET TRANSPARENCY AND PARTICIPATION
rows.abstract:
Seeks to ensure the responsibilities of all government agencies to propose, execute and deliver committed results in the Appropriations Act in a timely, predictable and economical manner; to strengthen the integration of planning, budgeting, accounting, disbursement, performance management, etc.; and to ensure ample safeguards in managing public finances.
Proposes to institutionalize the cash-based estimates in the proposed general and special appropriations; to reform the budget preparation process; to incorporate medium-term planning, particularly in infrastructure; to set safeguards for multi-year contracts to manage the availability of public resources and avoids contingent liabilities for government-initiated projects; to improve the management of liabilities, minimization of unanticipated contingent liabilities; and to provide for budgetary framework for clarifying the management of public resources in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A REVISED APPRENTICESHIP PROGRAM REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE CHAPTERS I AND II OF TITLE II OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Aims to provide the youth with skills and access to employment and provide enterprises with a mechanism to ensure a continuous supply of skilled workers.
Proposes to incorporate the involvement of the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) as the primary Technical Vocational Education and Training (TVET) authority; to set the duration of training according to the complexity of the skills to be learned; to provide for the issuance of training completion certificates; and to provide for a training allowance and disability and/or accident insurance.

rows.author: F061;I059;K119;
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2023-12-12, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-12-13 and received by the Senate on 2023-12-13
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL FRAMEWORK FOR WATER RESOURCE MANAGEMENT AND CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES AND THE WATER REGULATORY COMMISSION, DEFINING THEIR MANDATES, POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATINGS FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Intends to address the fragmented and uncoordinated governance and maintenance of our water resources in order to provide accessible, affordable, safe and reliable potable water and proper sanitation services.
Proposes to create a Department where all government agencies related to water shall be rationalized under it; to adopt the Integrated Water Resources Management (IWRM) as the strategic framework for policy-making and planning, etc.; and to create an independent Water Regulatory Commission that shall protect consumer welfare and reject abusive practices in the industry.

rows.author: 0000;F061;I059;K119;
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2023-03-06, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-03-07 and received by the Senate on 2023-03-07
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PROCEDURE FOR REGISTRATION OF VOTERS AND ADOPTING A SYSTEM OF ONLINE REGISTRATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 2, 3, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 27, 29, 32, 33 AND 45 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8189, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "VOTER´S REGISTRATION ACT OF 1996"
rows.abstract:
Intends to proscribe any actual or constructive restraint against the exercise of the right of suffrage to prevent disenfranchisement of voters; makes our electoral system more resilient to unexpected calamities, and provides the Filipino electorate and our government an efficient, convenient, and cost-effective mechanism for voter´s registration.
Defines the term “disinterested witness”; proposes for the system of continuing personal or electronic filing of application for registration of voters, or through the official website of the Commission.

rows.author: F061;I059;K119;
rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA11983 enacted on 2024-03-11
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NEW PASSPORT LAW, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8239, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "PHILIPPINE PASSPORT ACT OF 1996"
rows.abstract:
Seeks to guarantee the compliance of Phil. Passports to international standards set by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) - utilizing the latest tamper-proof, personalization, and data management technology.
Proposes to adopt the new biometric system and the submission of documents only issued or authenticated by the Phil. Statistics Authority (PSA); Seeks to provide a new type of “Emergency Passport” and the issuance of three types of “Travel Documents” for Filipinos with urgent travels; those who need to be repatriated; and for individuals considered as stateless persons, refugees, or asylum in the Philippines.

rows.abstract:
Proposes to adopt a market-based Schedule of Market Values (SMV) to be used as a basis of local and national real property taxation - valuation or appraisal, whether taxable or tax-exempt, shall be based on prevailing market values where the property is situated according to prescribed valuation standards.
Mandates the DOF to maintain valuation standards consistent with generally accepted international regulations and specifications; coordinates with BIR to review SMVs as prepared by the local government assessor; and provides technical assistance to government agencies, leadership, and policy direction to LGUs, uniform procedure on different transaction in the assessor´s office, and continuing research on valuation.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FRAMEWORK FOR BLUE ECONOMY, PROMOTING STEWARDSHIP AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT OF COASTAL AND MARINE ECOSYSTEMS AND RESOURCES
rows.abstract:
Aims to transform our ocean-based industries into sustainable activities-our maritime economy into a low-carbon, blue economy.
Defines several terms among others as follows:
Blue economy refers to a practical ocean-based economic model using green infrastructure and technologies, innovative financing mechanisms, and proactive institutional arrangements . . . protecting our oceans and coasts and enhancing its potential contribution to sustainable development, . . .reducing environmental risks and ecological scarcities.
Environmental-economic accounting refers to a systematic way to measure and report on stocks and flows of natural assets and resources - both biotic and abiotic, renewable and non-renewable - and ecosystem services, to determine the contribution of the environment to the economy and the impact of the economy on the environment.
Ocean-based activities refer to activities undertaken in the ocean, e.g. fisheries and aquaculture, offshore oil and gas, mining, ocean energy, desalination, shipping and marine transportation, marine tourism, marine construction. 
Ocean-related activities refer to activities that use products from the ocean (e.g. seafood processing, marine biotechnology, chemicals, salt, etc.) and produce products and services for the ocean and ocean-based activities (e.g. ship building and repair, ports, tourist resorts, communication, maritime insurance and law, maritime technical services, etc.)

rows.abstract:
Defines absolute divorce as the judicial dissolution of a marriage or the termination of the bond of matrimony where the spouses return to their status of being single with the right to contract marriage again.
Defines other terms among others as follows:  abandonment, alimony, bigamous marriage, child custody, court-assisted petitioner, domestic or marital abuse, irreconcilable differences, marital infidelity, psychological incapacity, sex reassignment surgery, transgender, and transsexual.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PILI INDUSTRY SUBSIDY FUND TO ENHANCE THE CULTIVATION, PRODUCTION, AND MARKETING OF PILI FOR DOMESTIC AND EXPORT TRADE
rows.abstract:
Proposes to create an initial amount of Three Hundred Million (P300,000,000.00) subsidy fund which shall be replenished annually in the General Appropriations Act, and shall be administered by the Department of Agriculture, in coordination with the DOST and the DTI.
Seeks to declare the Bicol Region consisting of the Provinces of Albay, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, Masbate and Sorsogon as the Pili regional capital of the Philippines; and to acknowledged the “Pili Regional Research and Technology Development Center.

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PEOPLE´S RIGHT TO INFORMATION
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide for mandatory disclosure of SALN declaration in the official website of several public offices; the disclosure of several public documents or records, among others as follows:  annual budget, collections/disbursement, income/expenditures, procurement plan/list, items for bidding, procurement contracts, construction or concession agreements, private sector participation contracts in infrastructure and development projects, public funding to any private entity, licenses/permits/agreements for the extraction/utilization of natural resources, updated plantilla/unfilled positions, compromise agreements, audited financial statements, revenue allotments and expenditures, guarantees given to GOCCs, etc., utilization of IRA, Special Education Fund, Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Fund, Local Development, Bilateral or multilateral agreements and treaties, loans from domestic and foreign financial institutions, loans, grants and donations for calamity-stricken areas.

rows.author: K087;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING GOVERNMENT AGENCIES TO INDICATE THE BLOOD TYPE OF INDIVIDUALS ON THEIR IDENTIFICATION CARDS, CERTIFICATES AND LICENSES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Proposes that an individual´s blood type must be duly certified by a pathologist to guarantee its accuracy.
Seeks to identify government-issued documents that shall bear the blood type of an individual as follows:  ID issued by the SSS/GSIS; passport issued by the DFA; professional ID card issued by the PRC; birth certificate issued by the Local Registrar´s Office or the PSA; driver´s license issued by the LTO; firearms license issued by the PNP; and such other certificates, licenses or ID documents that are to be issued after the effectivity of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2022-07-26

rows.author: K087;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A FREE ANNUAL MEDICAL CHECK-UP FOR FILIPINOS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: States that all Filipinos shall be entitled to the applicable benefits under the Philippine Health Insurance Program such as a free annual check-up -  which shall include blood sugar and cholesterol tests; Provides that laboratory and diagnostic tests shall be expanded, subject to the availability of funds.
rows.status: Measure approved by the Committee on 2023-02-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING ELECTRONIC VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN AND THEIR CHILDREN, PROVIDING PROTECTIVE MEASURES, AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9262, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “ANTI-VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN AND THEIR CHILDREN ACT OF 2004”
rows.abstract:
Intends to address the reported significant number of women encountering online gender-based violence in spite of the enactment of the Cybercrime Prevention Act and Anti-VAWC.
Seeks to identify and categorize acts that will be considered online violence or ICT-related violence against women and children and enumerates the corresponding penalties thereto; Expands the coverage of protection orders and confidentiality policy to include measures against online dissemination of electronic violence-related materials.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE MEDICAL RESERVE CORPS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish an MRC under DOH composed of licensed physicians, medical students, graduates of medicine, registered nurses, and licensed allied health professional who may be called upon to assist the government in addressing the medical needs of the public during national or local health emergencies which require manpower support.
Defines “Public Health Emergency” as stated in R.A.11332; Grants the President the power to mobilize the MRC nationwide in stipulated cases; Enlists the Armed Forces of the Phils.  in the organization, training in disaster and emergency response, and complement the MRC logistics and manpower; Establishes mobilization centers in every province and city as needed.

committee_action.action: Committee Report filed on 2022-12-06

rows.author: C019;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING THE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT OF DEUTERIUM AS A POSSIBLE SOURCE OF ALTERNATIVE ENERGY, CREATING THE PHILIPPINE DEUTERIUM RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFORE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to address the growing concerns on energy security and global warming resulting from the use of conventional fossil.
Defines several terms among others such as Hydrogen, Green Hydrogen, Renewable Energy Sources, Alternative Fuel, and Deuterium (an isotope of hydrogen that has one proton and one neutron on its nucleus and that has twice the mass of ordinary hydrogen, commonly known as “heavy water” and is used as fuel for nuclear fusion reactions).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NUCLEAR ENERGY since 2022-08-16

rows.author: C019;
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING DRUG PREVENTION AND CONTROL, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9165, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “COMPREHENSIVE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 2002”
rows.abstract:
Provides for, among others - a legal presumption of who is considered as the importer, financier, and protector or coddler of illegal drugs as well as legal consequences for importers and financiers, and their protectors or coddlers.
Defines “chemical substance dependence” and seeks to penalize negligent lessors of properties used as clandestine laboratories.
Refers “dangerous drugs” to the following:  50 grams or more of shabu, cocaine, cocaine hydrochloride, opium, heroine, morphine, marijuana resin or oil, or other dangerous drugs such as ecstasy, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DANGEROUS DRUGS since 2022-07-26

rows.author: C019;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE MAGNA CARTA OF BENEFITS FOR THE OFFICERS AND PERSONNEL OF THE PHILIPPINE DRUG ENFORCEMENT AGENCY
rows.abstract: Seeks to promote and improve the well-being and economic welfare of the men and women of PDEA by providing them with acceptable living and working conditions, better terms of employment, and career opportunities in order to effectively carry out their mandate.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DANGEROUS DRUGS since 2022-07-26

rows.author: C019;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING BENEFITS AND PRIVILEGES TO JUNIOR CITIZENS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to develop a comprehensive program of benefits and privileges for children aged Zero (0) to Twelve (12) whose annual family income does not exceed P250,000.00; Proposes to grant 20% discount and exemption from the VAT on the sale of several goods and services from all establishments for the exclusive use of the junior citizen.
Provides for guidelines and mechanism of compulsory rebates in the sharing of burden of discounts, among retailers, manufacturers and distributors, taking into consideration their respective margins to several purchases and services: medicines including vaccines; essential medical supplies, etc.; milk supplements; physician´s fees; licensed professional health providing home health care services; medical and dental services, diagnostic/laboratory fees; admission fees to theaters, cinema houses and concert halls, and the likes; funeral and burial services.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WELFARE OF CHILDREN since 2023-08-23

rows.author: C019;
rows.mother_status: Business for the day on 2024-02-07
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING ANTI-DRUG ABUSE COUNCIL IN ALL PROVINCES, CITIES, MUNICIPALITIES, AND BARANGAYS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create Provincial, City, Municipal and Barangay Anti-Drug Councils to ensure the smooth implementation of anti-drug abuse programs and services especially at the local level.
Provides for drug rehabilitation program consisting of medical rehabilitation, reformatory rehabilitation and community-based drug rehabilitation program.

rows.author: C019;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE DNA DATABASE SYSTEM
rows.abstract:
Seeks to institutionalize a national forensic DNA (Deoxyribonucleic Acid) database whose function is to produce matches between the suspected individual and crime scene bio-makers in order to: 
a. provide evidence to support criminal investigations which can lead to the identity of potential suspect/s in criminal investigation; 
b. assist in the identification of missing persons or unidentified human remains in times of accidents and calamities; and 
c. to establish paternity and other family relationships. Defines DNA profiling or DNA typing as a process where a minute sample of genetic DNA material is taken from a human tissue and is given a computerized numeric value in the form of a "bar code".
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2022-07-26

rows.author: C019;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 4200, ENTITLED, “AN ACT TO PROHIBIT AND PENALIZE WIRE TAPPING AND OTHER RELATED VIOLATIONS OF THE PRIVACY OF COMMUNICATION”
rows.abstract:
Aims to keep pace with advancement in communications and telecommunications to protect privacy; and for the government to go after criminal syndicates who make use of new technology in their illegal operations.
Seeks to prohibit public telecommunication entities engaged in voice and data transmission to retain data for more than one year, except those which are the subject of a pending case.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2022-07-26

rows.abstract: States that all Filipino citizens who are eighteen (18) years old and above with PhilSys Number (PSN) shall have a government bank account called OneAccount where all payments to him/her from the government institutions and authorities shall be directly deposited, such as but not limited to tax refunds, pensions, and social ameliorations.

rows.author: J036;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF DIALYSIS CLINICS IN ALL NATIONAL, REGIONAL AND PROVINCIAL HOSPITALS AND PROVIDING FOR FREE DIALYSIS TREATMENTS TO INDIGENT PATIENTS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the kidney problem situation in the country especially for Filipinos living below poverty line by establishing a Dialysis ward or unit in all national, regional and provincial government hospital.
Defines “Indigent Patient” to a patient whose combined annual family income does not exceed thirty thousand pesos (P30,000.00).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2022-07-26
